questions.Description:
Testing of metal / non-metals materials for
a)      Tensile
b)      Compression
c)      Hardness
d)     Bending

Fabrication of Composite materials –
a)        Make 300x300mm Glass fabric with epoxy resin system with room
temperature curing  system.
b)        Thickness min 2mm and above

Testing Composite laminates
a)      Tension
b)       Inter laminar shear stress (ILSS)
c)        Flexure Test

Single Lap Shear Strength Test.
a)    Single Lap shear strength  using  aluminium  adherents  and  room
temperature  urable
b)     adhesives ( like AV 130 + HV 998 or any commercially available
adhesives)

Sheet Metal Shop
a)         Single row riveting exercises
b)       Double row riveting practice

Riveting repair by insertion
a)  Cutting and bending exercises on Aluminium sheets
b)   Pneumatic Riveting Exercise
